payload.title: [server-storage-7] StreamStore.pruneRetention deletes by stream_type across ALL tenants/apps (by design, but uns...
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING server-storage-7 (info/data-loss, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/storage/stream-store.ts
LINES: 404-439

WHAT: pruneRetention()'s maxAgeMs branch runs `DELETE FROM stream_events WHERE stream_type = ? AND created_at < ?` with no tenant_id/app_id scope, so an operator retention policy keyed on a stream type prunes that type's events for every tenant and every app uniformly. The maxEvents branch is correctly per-(tenant,stream,streamId) via its correlated subquery. This is the documented FR-145 design (operator-configured, server-wide per-stream-type retention, invoked from store.ts:695 with a single global policy map), not a request-reachable path, so it is not a cross-tenant leak — but the global blast radius of the age-based DELETE is worth flagging: a misconfigured maxAgeMs deletes history for all tenants of that stream type at once.

IMPACT: Operationally: one over-aggressive retention policy value silently affects every tenant's data for that stream type. Not externally triggerable; purely an operator-footgun / blast-radius note.

SUGGESTED FIX: If per-tenant retention is ever desired, thread tenant_id/app_id into pruneRetention and the DELETE. Otherwise document loudly that retention is server-wide per stream type and validate policy values before applying.
